name: GEOHAN
recent: Geohan 于 2026 年 8 月获得 Chin Hin Property 一份价值 RM37mil 的高层住宅土方工程合约。最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收环比增长 17.7%，但录得净亏损 RM0.97mil。董事经理 Lee Kim Seng 于 8 月底在公开市场增持公司股份。
notable: 获得 Chin Hin Property 价值 RM37mil 的高层住宅土方工程合约。
董事经理 Lee Kim Seng 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日及 28 日合计增持约 606 万股。
risks: 最新季度录得净亏损 RM0.97mil，净利率为 -0.8%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 RM121.821mil，环比增长 17.7%；净亏损 RM0.97mil，净利率 -0.8%，而上一季度净利率为 1.4%。

recent_en: In August 2026, Geohan secured a RM37mil earthwork contract for a high-rise residential project from Chin Hin Property. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue rise 17.7% QoQ but a net loss of RM0.97mil. Managing Director Lee Kim Seng acquired shares in the open market in late August.
notable_en: Secured a RM37mil earthwork contract for a high-rise residential project from Chin Hin Property.
Managing Director Lee Kim Seng acquired a total of about 6.06 million shares on 26 and 28 August 2026.
risks_en: The latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM0.97mil, with a net margin of -0.8%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM121.821mil, up 17.7% QoQ; net loss was RM0.97mil with a net margin of -0.8%, compared with a net margin of 1.4% in the previous quarter.
